writes.rule: Per subtopic seen: pMastery 0.7 if right at D2/D3, 0.55 if right at D1, 0.25 if wrong; level L0-L3 from the ladder step reached
Prerequisite-gap index = 100 x weighted misses / weighted items seen in slots 1-4, averaged over groups
Groups with the highest Part A percent (top 1-2, only if >= 65%)
Groups with the lowest Part A percent (bottom 1-2, only if < 65%)
Calibration = 1 - mean |confidence/5 - correct| over Part A (feeds the first MCI reading)
Highest difficulty answered correctly twice in a row: D1 low, D2 medium, D3 high
Verbal reasoning = percent of Part B verbal items right
Numerical reasoning = percent of Part B numerical items right
Abstract reasoning = percent of Part B abstract items right
Spatial reasoning = percent of Part B spatial items right
Logical deduction = percent right on Part B items tagged p65
Numeracy fluency = numerical percent scaled by speed (right answers under target time count 1.2x, max 100)
Processing speed = 100 x share of Part B items answered right within target seconds
RIASEC profile: each career-interest item scored 1-5; letter score = mean of its 2 items; top 3 letters form the code (e.g. IRC)

items.markingKey: C. without oxygen. An- means without

items.answer: It shows the tension was building and about to burst

It shows the tension was building and about to burst
It shows the classroom was hot from cooking
It shows the exam was easy
items.markingKey: B. It shows the tension was building and about to burst. A pressure cooker builds pressure until it releases

items.markingKey: C. claim. Evidence supports the claim

Some say uniforms limit students' self-expression.

items.stem: A writer says: 'Everyone I know hates homework, so homework should be banned.' What is the main weakness?
items.answer: The evidence is a small, personal sample
options: It is written in the first person
The evidence is a small, personal sample
items.markingKey: D. The evidence is a small, personal sample. A few friends do not represent everyone

items.stem: Which of these is a complex sentence?
items.answer: When the bell rang, the students rushed out.
options: When the bell rang, the students rushed out.
The bell rang and the students rushed out.
items.markingKey: B. When the bell rang, the students rushed out.. It has a main clause and a subordinate clause

items.stem: A story reads: 'The door creaked. Silence. Then footsteps.' What is the effect of the short sentences?
options: They make the story feel relaxed
They show the writer ran out of ideas
They explain the setting in detail
items.markingKey: D. They build tension and suspense. Short, broken sentences slow the reader and create suspense
